create.name: Gokula (Nanda-bhavana)
create.about: Where Vasudeva brought the newborn Kṛṣṇa to Nanda and Yaśodā; Nanda-bhavana with the deities of Nanda and Yaśodā, Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, and the place of the cradle.

create.name: Brahmāṇḍa-ghāṭa
create.location: On the Yamunā near Mahāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where baby Kṛṣṇa ate earth and showed Yaśodā the whole universe (brahmāṇḍa) in His mouth.

create.name: Rāval
create.location: On the Yamunā, north of Gokula (coordinates approximate)
create.about: The birthplace of Śrī Rādhā, daughter of Vṛṣabhānu and Kīrtidā, who found Her on a lotus in the Yamunā; the deities of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are worshipped here.

create.name: Akrūra-ghāṭa
create.location: On the Yamunā between Mathurā and Vṛndāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Bathing here, Akrūra saw Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma in the water and in Vaikuṇṭha. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Akrūra-ghāṭa during His visit to Vṛndāvana.

create.name: Seva-kuñja
create.about: Where Kṛṣṇa served Śrī Rādhā in the night (one of the twelve forests of Vṛndāvana, Nikuñjavana); Lalitā-kuṇḍa is here, and the Rādhā-Dāmodara temple stands within its area.

create.name: Nidhuvana
create.about: A grove of the Divine Couple's night pastimes; Svāmī Haridāsa, whose singing even Emperor Akbar came to hear, did bhajana here, found Śrī Bāṅke-bihārī, and his samādhi is here.

create.name: Vaṁśīvaṭa
create.location: On the Yamunā in Vṛndāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: The banyan under which Kṛṣṇa played His flute to call the gopīs to the rāsa; Madhu Paṇḍita found the deity of Śrī Gopīnātha here.

create.name: Imlītalā
create.location: On the Yamunā in Vṛndāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Under this ancient tamarind (imlī) tree Kṛṣṇa sat in separation from Rādhā; Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also sat here, absorbed in Her mood.

create.name: Śṛṅgāravaṭa
create.location: A little east of Imlītalā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where Kṛṣṇa decorated Śrīmatī Rādhikā with flowers; later Nityānanda Prabhu's place in Vṛndāvana.

create.name: Cīra-ghāṭa
create.location: On the Yamunā in Vṛndāvana (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where Kṛṣṇa took the clothes (cīra) of the bathing gopīs and climbed into the kadamba tree on the bank.

create.name: Gopīśvara Mahādeva
create.about: Śiva, who took the form of a gopī to enter the rāsa, protects Vṛndāvana as Gopīśvara. Sanātana Gosvāmī came daily for his darśana until, in old age, Gopīśvara told him in a dream not to walk so far.

create.name: Brahma-kuṇḍa (Vṛndāvana)
create.about: Where Brahmā, after stealing the calves and cowherd boys, offered prayers to Kṛṣṇa.

create.name: Raṅgajī temple
create.about: A large temple of Śrī Raṅganātha in South Indian style, built in 1851 by Lakṣmīcanda Seth.

create.name: Bāṅke-bihārī temple
create.about: Śrī Bāṅke-bihārī, the deity that Svāmī Haridāsa found in Nidhuvana.

create.name: Vaṅkhaṇḍī Mahādeva
create.location: At the end of Āṭhkhambā, coming from the Bāṅke-bihārī temple (coordinates approximate)
create.about: When Sanātana Gosvāmī grew old, Gopīśvara Mahādeva told him in a dream that he would come nearer to his bhajana-kuṭī, and appeared here.
